public_rationale: The available disclosures establish that Anthropic is a major AWS customer. They do not establish that it occupied more than 75% of Amazon's AI capacity. Neither Rainier's size nor future capacity commitments settle the percentage. The search also did not establish a comparable allocation share at publication.
limitations: Customer allocation records may be private.
The claim mixes a dated denominator with present-tense language.
Capacity measures and hardware coverage are not clearly defined.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: He would be confident in assuming that more than 75% of Amazon's capacity is taken up by Anthropic.

statement.excerpt: I’d be confident in assuming that more than 75% of its capacity is taken up by Anthropic.
statement.document_title: Am I Meant To Be Impressed?

from_speaker: its capacity is taken up by Anthropic
As of the end of Q4 2025
our_interpretation: Read capacity as Amazon's operational AI accelerator capacity, including Trainium, because the supporting example is Project Rainier.
Use year-end 2025, the explicit date attached to the capacity denominator. The present-tense wording could alternatively refer to publication.
Treat the statement as an estimate of an actual allocation share. Confidence in an assumption is not itself evidence of that share.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish that Anthropic occupied more than 75% of Amazon's operational AI accelerator capacity at the stated date.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish that Anthropic occupied 75% or less of that capacity.
